cases.assertion: A direct peer or another subscribed authorized channel member sees typing until stop or expiration. Repeated events are limited and no event is persisted.
Unrelated users, blocked direct pairs and channel users whose access is revoked cannot send or receive the typing event.
An explicit displayed cursor advances the viewer's position, updates unread counts across the viewer's devices and displays the receipt to the message sender.
A foreign or deleted cursor returns 400, a nonparticipant receives 403 and a read-only history fetch does not change the cursor.
